title: Normality or weak normality of eight-variable quartics
summary: Determine whether every quartic Boolean function on eight variables is normal or weakly normal.

formal_statement.body: For a Boolean function $f:\mathbb F_2^8\to\mathbb F_2$, let $\deg_4(f)=\min_{a,V:\,\dim V=4}\deg(f|_{a+V})$. Prove or refute the conjecture that every function $f$ of algebraic degree exactly $4$ satisfies $\deg_4(f)\le 1$. Equivalently, every eight-variable quartic Boolean function is normal or weakly normal; bentness is not assumed.

scope.domain: Quartic Boolean functions and affine-flat normality
assumptions: f : F_2^8 -> F_2 has algebraic degree exactly 4
f is not required to be bent
Normality and weak normality use the source's affine-flat definitions
scope.unresolved_remainder: The conjecture remains open over all quartic Boolean functions on eight variables. A counterexample must have relative degree deg_4(f) >= 2.

citations.label: Gillot--Langevin--Polujan, normality of 8-bit bent functions
citations.locator: Eq. (III.1) and Section VI, item 3, p. 4364

progress.summary: The source conjectures that every eight-variable quartic Boolean function is normal or weakly normal.
